name: 08-turn-truncation
description: turn() cuts each string and each message content at maxLength, default 1024, and sets <key>.truncated. Tool call inputs are not cut, and app.turn.messages stays valid JSON.
covers: practice 1: each string is cut at options.maxLength and sets <key>.truncated, and a string within the limit has no flag
practice 1: each message content is cut on its own, a cut sets app.turn.messages.truncated, and tool call inputs are not cut
practice 1: the default length limit is 1024
practice 1: app.turn.messages keeps the role, content, toolCalls, toolName and toolCallId of each message
